# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Engine maintenance update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates upstream Skia m158 bug fixes. The shared hash-code implementation also switches to operating-system cryptographic randomness for its per-process seed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Refresh Skia m158 fixes** — Updates the bundled engine with upstream fixes from chrome/m158. ([#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Use cryptographic hash seeding** — The shared HashCode implementation in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now obtains its seed from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
